context.transcript:
Thank you all for coming to the grand opening of the Gerhard Vogel exhibit here at the International Music Museum.
Our museum curators worked hard to create this permanent exhibit.
As you know, Mr. Vogel is a world-renowned violinist.
All the items in the collection were kindly donated by Mr. Vogel last year.
His legacy will continue for many years to come through this priceless collection.
To commemorate the exhibit opening, we are selling signed posters featuring Mr. Vogel with his violin.
These are available in our gift shop.
context.transcript_translation:
感谢大家来到国际音乐博物馆参加 Gerhard Vogel 的展览开幕式。
我们的馆长们努力创建了这个永久性展品。
如您所知，Vogel 先生是一位世界著名的小提琴家。
收藏中的所有物品都是去年由 Vogel 先生慷慨捐赠的。
通过这个无价的收藏，他的精神遗产将在未来许多年继续传承。
为纪念展览开幕，我们正在出售以 Vogel 先生和他的小提琴为特色的签名海报。
这些可以在我们的礼品店购买到。
